aarti.pad1: Śiva, you are true, eternal, beautiful, the master of all;
changeless, imperishable, unborn, the indweller who knows all from within.
aarti.pad2: You are the beginning, the infinite, free of all ill, without parts yet bearer of every kalā;
stainless, formless, beyond the senses, unmoving, the remover of sin.
aarti.pad3: Brahmā, Viṣṇu and Maheśvara: you bear all three forms;
you alone are the maker, the provider, the upholder and the destroyer.
aarti.pad4: You are the protector and the devourer, the one who sets all in motion, the beloved, the giver who gives freely without reckoning;
the witness, the supreme non-doer, and also the doer who owns the deed.
aarti.pad5: You dwell in a palace of gems, the great enjoyer, full of attachment;
and ever roaming the cremation ground, you are the yogī, the dispassionate.
aarti.pad6: You wear the hide and the skull, poison in your throat, a garland of skulls and serpents;
your body smeared with the ashes of the pyre, three-eyed, you are the refuge of Mahākālī.
aarti.pad7: Ghosts and goblins serve you well; you wear tawny matted locks.
Unclothed, of fearsome form, you are Rudra who brings the world's dissolution.
aarti.pad8: You are white and gentle, bearer of the Gaṅgā, bearer of the moon, giver of happiness;
most lovely, bringer of peace, auspicious, captivating the minds of the sages.
aarti.pad9: O Lord, you are without attributes and with them, stainless, pervading the world, eternal.
O all-pervading one, you are Time itself in form, the One alone, Hara, beyond time.
aarti.pad10: You are being, consciousness and bliss, full of rasa, full of compassion, the sustainer of all;
the ocean of the nectar of love, the most beloved, the saviour of the whole universe.
aarti.pad11: We are utterly lowly, merciful one: give us the refuge of your feet;
make our understanding pure in every way, and make us your own.
